name: vela-rbxts-lsp
description: Completions, hover, diagnostics, and color previews for vela-rbxts classNames in roblox-ts.
author: astra-void

velaRbxts.lsp.serverPath.description: Optional path to the standalone vela-rbxts LSP executable. When empty, the extension uses the published @vela-rbxts/lsp wrapper package when its matching platform binary dependency is installed.

velaRbxts.lsp.trace.server.description: Trace level forwarded to the vela-rbxts language client.

velaRbxts.lsp.enabled.description: Enable the standalone vela-rbxts Rust LSP integration for TypeScript and TSX files.

velaRbxts.classFunctions.markdownDescription: Helpers whose string arguments are class lists wherever they are called, such as `["cn", "cva"]`. Inside `className` every call is already read; this extends completions, hover and diagnostics to calls outside it, including `tw` tagged templates and cva-style variant maps.

velaRbxts.validate.description: Publish vela-rbxts diagnostics. Completions, hover and colors keep working when this is off.

velaRbxts.lint.markdownDescription: Severity per diagnostic code, replacing the default one, for example `{ "overridden-class": "ignore", "unknown-theme-key": "error" }`. The code is shown beside every vela-rbxts diagnostic.

velaRbxts.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show what each vela class lowers to — the Roblox properties and helper instances — inline after the class. Off by default: the summaries are for reading a class list back rather than for every edit.

scripts.package:vsix: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:loader && pnpm run build && node ./scripts/package-vsix.cjs
